tokenizer.scope: logical request and reply JSON, including retries; no chat framing/catalog/adapters/model usage
tokenizer.serialization: json.dumps(call[field], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')) for request and reply separately on every call

method.cache: fresh process per case; OS caches not flushed; no cold-cache or warm-runtime-cache claims
method.memory_limit_note: sampled early-stop threshold, not kernel hard limit
